raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The teardrop-shaped opacity at the caudal end of an azygos fissure is formed by the azygos vein; following pneumothorax and chest tube placement, the re-expansion of the lung or shift in mediastinal structures can displace the azygos vein medially out of the fissure, causing the characteristic opacity to disappear from its expected location.
